html:
SMTO-KV-0009 — This work was deleted, so its scratch notes can't be used

GUID: 6f3e12e6-8abc-4656-998a-3c55d7fc066a
Slug: kv-conversation-deleted
Domain: KV · Subsystem: kv

What happened

  • The Agent tried to use scratch notes that belong to a Task or conversation that was deleted, for example while a Run was still going. Nothing was saved or read.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Select New chat and send your request there. Scratch notes belong to one Task, and deleted work never accepts notes again.
  2. If the deleted conversation's work wasn't finished, describe what is left in your first message in the new conversation. The new Task starts with empty scratch notes, so the Agent needs the details again.

What success looks like

  • The Run in the new conversation saves notes, shown as Saved task scratch data, without this error.

If it still fails

  • If this appears for work you did not delete, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't try to bring back the deleted work's notes; they can't be reopened.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Agent KV rejected the operation because the task scope has a deletion fence in agent_kv_deleted_conversations, written when its Task or conversation was deleted.

What this means

  • The store's operation transaction finds a tombstone for the conversation before accessing its KV entries. KV checks apply only to the selected conversation. Rejected validation or compare-and-set does not authorize an unconditional replacement; diagnostics do not read or mutate additional stored values.

Why this can happen

  • The store's operation transaction finds a tombstone for the conversation before accessing its KV entries.

How to diagnose it

  • Confirm the intended live conversation identity instead of recreating data under a deleted ID.

How to fix it

  • Task deletion (task_deletion.py) and conversation deletion (conversation_management.py) call retire_scopes_in in src/agent_runtime/kv/lifecycle.py, which fences the scope against late access permanently. Run the work in a live task scope; do not remove the agent_kv_deleted_conversations row to reopen the deleted scope.
  • Choose or create a live conversation; do not write into a deleted scope.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • The operation runs only in the intended live conversation scope.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • KV checks apply only to the selected conversation. Rejected validation or compare-and-set does not authorize an unconditional replacement; diagnostics do not read or mutate additional stored values.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
